title: libartifact: fix unnamed artifact orphans on re-pull
body:
<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->
Re-pulling an artifact when a tag moves leaves the previous manifest in the OCI layout index without `org.opencontainers.image.ref.name` (c/image `addManifest` strips the old name). That breaks `artifact ls` and `artifact rm`.

Implements [artifact-unnamed-orphans.md](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/contrib/design-docs/artifact-unnamed-orphans.md):
- **B1** - Before `copyArtifact` on pull, move the pull tag on the *previous* manifest to `repo@sha256:<digest>` so the new manifest can take the tag without leaving an unnamed entry. Restore the tag on copy failure (`defer`). Index updates use atomic writes.
- **C1** - On store open, delete legacy index entries that still have no `org.opencontainers.image.ref.name` (cannot recover repo for those orphans).

Podman B2/B3 and vendor bump are out of scope here.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28033  
Related: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29658

In the description and commit, you're talking about "retag", but I think you're releasing, no?  If so, please change those for historical reasons.

Also, my AI review suggested adding a couple of tests as follows.  Please consider:

```
diff --git a/common/pkg/libartifact/store_test.go b/common/pkg/libartifact/store_test.go
index 59af58f014..b7e4c0d000 100644
--- a/common/pkg/libartifact/store_test.go
+++ b/common/pkg/libartifact/store_test.go
@@ -978,6 +978,78 @@ func TestNewArtifactStore_removesUnnamedOrphans(t *testing.T) {
 	assert.Equal(t, namedRef, artifacts[0].Name)
 }
 
+// TestPull_releaseThenCopyKeepsOldDigestNamed exercises the Pull retag sequence
+// without a registry: release the tag to repo@digest, then layout→layout copy of
+// new content onto the same tag (what c/image does during pull).
+func TestPull_releaseThenCopyKeepsOldDigestNamed(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := t.Context()
+	asSrc, _ := setupTestStore(t)
+	asDest, _ := setupTestStore(t)
+
+	tagName := "quay.io/test/retag-pull:latest"
+	digestA, _ := helperAddArtifact(t, asDest, tagName, map[string]int{"old.txt": 64}, nil)
+	digestB, _ := helperAddArtifact(t, asSrc, tagName, map[string]int{"new.txt": 128}, nil)
+	require.NotEqual(t, digestA.String(), digestB.String(), "digests must differ to simulate a retagged pull")
+
+	ref, err := NewArtifactReference(tagName)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	srcRef, err := layout.NewReference(asSrc.storePath, tagName)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	destRef, err := layout.NewReference(asDest.storePath, tagName)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	asDest.lock.Lock()
+	previous := asDest.getManifestDigestForTag(tagName)
+	require.Equal(t, *digestA, previous)
+
+	require.NoError(t, asDest.releaseTaggedManifestForPull(ref, previous))
+
+	copiedDigest, err := asDest.copyArtifact(ctx, srcRef, destRef, libimage.CopyOptions{})
+	asDest.lock.Unlock()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, digestB.String(), copiedDigest.String())
+
+	artifacts, err := asDest.List(ctx)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, artifacts, 2, "old and new digests should both remain listable")
+
+	byDigest := make(map[string]string, len(artifacts))
+	for _, a := range artifacts {
+		require.NotEmpty(t, a.Name, "no unnamed orphans after release+copy")
+		byDigest[a.Digest.String()] = a.Name
+	}
+
+	wantOldName, err := ref.DigestReference(*digestA)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, wantOldName, byDigest[digestA.String()], "previous digest should keep repo@sha256 name")
+	assert.Equal(t, tagName, byDigest[digestB.String()], "new digest should hold the pull tag")
+}
+
+// TestPull_copyWithoutReleaseLeavesUnnamed documents the pre-fix failure mode:
+// copying a new digest onto an existing tag strips ref.name from the old entry.
+func TestPull_copyWithoutReleaseLeavesUnnamed(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := t.Context()
+	asSrc, _ := setupTestStore(t)
+	asDest, _ := setupTestStore(t)
+
+	tagName := "quay.io/test/orphan-pull:latest"
+	_, _ = helperAddArtifact(t, asDest, tagName, map[string]int{"old.txt": 64}, nil)
+	_, _ = helperAddArtifact(t, asSrc, tagName, map[string]int{"new.txt": 128}, nil)
+
+	srcRef, err := layout.NewReference(asSrc.storePath, tagName)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	destRef, err := layout.NewReference(asDest.storePath, tagName)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	_, err = asDest.copyArtifact(ctx, srcRef, destRef, libimage.CopyOptions{})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	index := readIndex(t, asDest)
+	var unnamed int
+	for _, desc := range index.Manifests {
+		if desc.Annotations[specV1.AnnotationRefName] == "" {
+			unnamed++
+		}
+	}
+	assert.GreaterOrEqual(t, unnamed, 1, "without release, re-tag copy should leave an unnamed index entry")
+}
```
